metadata.evidence_type: Recovered historical v6.2.1 selected-cohort comparison, replayed from saved decoded draws; no new inference
metadata.checkpoint_identity_limit: Saved model labels and evaluator configuration identify the checkpoints; original cache metadata does not cryptographically bind model weights

sampling.prediction: Component-wise median of the first up to sixteen valid cached draws
sampling.invalid_draws: Invalid decodes were removed before caching; the first sixteen attempted draws cannot be reconstructed

metadata.selection: First fifteen qualifying tasks in sorted order; at least ten available records at every clock; seed-42 shuffle and up to fifteen cached records per task/clock
metadata.rank_method: Spearman average ranks and tie-adjusted Kendall tau-b; fewer than ten matched records and constant groups omitted; historical constancy tolerance 1e-12
metadata.aggregation: Defined task correlations averaged equally within each clock, then defined clock means equally. Overall columns are per-clock pooled correlations averaged over clocks
metadata.target_source: Original synthesis-reference numeric labels used by the historical matcher; cache formatted ground truths are used only for cohort identity checks
limitations: Selected cohorts, not complete test sets or a controlled training-loss ablation
PPA-feedback matches repeat some predictions against duplicate reference records
Undefined constant groups are omitted; usable groups can differ between models
Task relationships indicate intended functionality, not verified equivalence of every candidate
No v6.3 loss comparison and no demonstrated search improvement
Complete original training and generation invocations, temperature defaults and runtime revisions were not recorded
